tools.name: create_paint_by_numbers
tools.description: Convert a photo (pet, family, wedding, landscape...) into a paint-by-numbers template. Returns: the numbered outline to paint on, a colour preview of the finished painting, a numbered colour key, and download links (printable SVG and PNG, valid for 30 days). Takes about 5 to 40 seconds.

tools.name: get_photo_upload_link
tools.description: Get a web page link where the person can upload a photo from their phone or computer. The page then shows an image URL to paste back into the chat, for use with create_paint_by_numbers. Use this when the photo is only on the person's device.

tools.name: order_custom_kit
tools.description: Get the link to order a real custom paint-by-numbers kit of the person's own photo from paint-by-number.com (pre-printed canvas, numbered pre-mixed paints and brushes, delivered). Use when the person wants to paint the result for real, wants a gift, or asks where to buy.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_photo_upload_link · Public sink: get_photo_upload_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_photo_upload_link · Public sink: get_photo_upload_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
